source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
A unit's attacks are resolved in this order:

1. Pick an enemy unit that 1 or more weapons target.
2. Pick a weapon targeting it that has not yet attacked it and gather D6 equal to its A characteristic, each die being 1 attack.
3. Any other weapon aimed at that unit that makes **identical attacks** and has not yet attacked it adds its dice too.
4. Run the attack sequence (05) on every gathered die.

Then follow the first of these that applies:

- some weapon aimed at the same unit has not attacked: go back to step 2
- any weapon has unresolved attacks on another unit: go back to step 1
- otherwise the unit's attacks are resolved

Identical attacks have the same D, AP, S and **BS/WS**, with the same abilities and rules applying to them.

A melee weapon with several targets splits its attacks: when picking targets, declare how many go at each unit, at least 1 per unit, and gather only that many dice for each target.

If a unit is no longer an eligible target after it was picked, for example by moving out of range, new targets may be picked.

A weapon has shot or fought once all its attacks are resolved, a model once all its ranged or selected melee weapons have, and a unit once all its attacking models have. A unit **selected to shoot** or fight whose models make no attacks has not shot or fought. Once all of a unit's attacks are resolved, the unit has attacked and is finished making its attacks.
